summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on inconsistent 'odd values' for frequency when viewing daily granularity data. It was noted that the system might default to a frequency of 1, which sometimes disappears or reappears upon page reload.

It was discussed that such strange values are usually indicative of an issue with the ML-API, but this is not confirmed as testing on the ML-API for frequency is new. The initial scope for Finland deployment only included 'City' and 'Bus_Shelter' categories. Even when expanding the category selection, the problem (frequency=1 changing upon reload) persisted.
decisions: The issue of inconsistent frequency values requires further investigation.
action_items: [p1] needs to reproduce the issue and provide a share link for review.
